> 第887章 见面礼（第1页）
狐九月恢复了个七七八八，将涂山的一应事宜安排完毕后，顾云直接返回了铜月狼族。
而巧合的是，就在他离开后不久，涂山清秋也从疗养之中走出。
多亏了顾云和狐九月发现的生命之树，在如此神物的滋养让她身上的伤势好了七七八八，她的气息较之大战前又凝实了几分，甚至隐隐有了向五劫迈进的趋势。
与王昊天的相遇，就好像打开了什么开关一样，让她原本停滞的修为又开始松动。
她沐过更衣，将连日闭关的尘垢洗净，换上那袭浅白色的族长袍服，对着铜镜拢好鬓发。
镜中人眉眼清冷，依旧是那个端方矜持的涂山之主，涂山清秋微微一笑，随后离开了寝殿。
神识如潮水般铺展开来，掠过涂山的每一寸土地。
长老们在议事堂中围坐，巡山弟子在各自岗位上轮值，一切都井然有序，唯独那道让她数次分神的玄色身影，遍寻不见。
涂山清秋的眉头微微蹙起，脚步不由自主地加快了几分。
她没有惊动任何人，径直穿过回廊，推开偏殿的门。
狐九月正伏在案牍边批阅涂山的日常事务文书，手边堆着小山似的玉简，眉宇间满是疲色。
听到门响，她抬起头来，眼中闪过一丝惊喜。
“族长姐姐，你出关了，你的伤怎么样了，好了吗？”
看着涂山清秋走入，狐九月抬眸，眼中闪过一抹惊喜的色彩。
涂山清秋走到案前，目光在殿中扫了一圈，状似不经意地开口，“他呢？跑到哪里去了？”
她低声回应道：“殿下之前与银月狼族有约定，现在应该已经在前往的路上了吧。”
涂山清秋的声音不自觉地提高了几分。
话刚出口她便意识到失态，旋即拢了拢袖口，轻咳一声，语气恢复了几分端肃，“他走之前，可曾说什么时候回来？”
“殿下身为人族，本就不能在妖域之中待太久。”
狐九月的嘴角勾起一抹狡黠的笑意，她垂着脑袋，同时用眼角余光清晰地瞥见，涂山清秋地指尖微微一颤——那只方才还从容拢着袖口的手，此刻正扣在案几边缘，指节泛白。
窗外有风穿过竹林，将案上的文书吹得哗哗作响——
涂山清秋的声音很淡，淡得像是在复述一句无关紧要的闲话。
“族长姐姐……”狐九月放下笔，小心翼翼地站起身来，“殿下他走得急，并没有明说，这也只是我的猜测而已。”
“银月狼族那边的事情办完了，说不定就——”
涂山清秋的脸色无比僵硬：“既然他走了，那就不用回来了。”
“我们涂山也没到离了一个人族就运转不了的地步！”
“行了，干好你的事情，这段时间我可能会经常闭关，涂山的担子就都压在你的身上了。”
涂山清秋拍拍狐九月的肩膀，转身直接离去。
徒留狐九月一脸懵逼，“不要啊，族长姐姐，他还回来的，还回来的，我刚刚只是玩笑话而已，玩笑……”

> Chapter 887 Meeting Gift (Page 1)
Hu Jiuyue recovered a lot, and after arranging Tushan's affairs, Gu Yun returned directly to the Copper Moon Wolf Clan.
Coincidentally, shortly after he left, Tushan Qingqiu also walked out of the convalescence.
Thanks to the Tree of Life discovered by Gu Yun and Hu Jiuyue, her injuries were healed by the nourishment of such a divine object. Her aura was a bit firmer than before the war, and she even had a faint tendency to move towards the Five Tribulations.
The encounter with Wang Haotian was like turning on some switch, causing her originally stagnant cultivation to loosen up again.
She bathed and changed her clothes, washed away the dirt from days of seclusion, put on the light white clan robe, and combed her temples in front of the bronze mirror.
The person in the mirror had cold eyebrows and was still the upright and reserved Lord of Tushan. Tushan Qingqiu smiled slightly and then left the dormitory.
Divine consciousness spread out like a tide, passing through every inch of Tushan.
The elders were sitting around in the meeting hall, and the mountain patrol disciples were taking turns taking turns at their respective posts. Everything was in order, except for the black figure that distracted her several times. She could not find it anywhere.
Tushan Qingqiu's brows frowned slightly, and his steps involuntarily accelerated a bit.
Without alerting anyone, she walked straight through the corridor and opened the door to the side hall.
Hu Jiuyue was crouching beside the papers to review Tu Shan's daily affairs documents. He had a mountain of jade slips piled up in his hand, and his brows were full of fatigue.
When she heard the door knock, she raised her head, a hint of surprise flashed in her eyes.
"Sister Patriarch, you are out of isolation. How is your injury? Is it healed?"
Seeing Tu Shan Qingqiu walking in, Hu Jiuyue raised his eyes, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
Tushan Qingqiu walked to the case, glanced around the hall, and said casually, "Where is he? Where did he go?"
She responded in a low voice: "Your Highness had an agreement with the Silver Moon Wolf Clan before, and he should be on his way there now."
Tushan Qingqiu's voice unconsciously raised a few points.
As soon as the words came out of her mouth, she realized that she had lost her temper. She immediately closed her sleeves, coughed slightly, and her tone returned to a more serious tone, "Before he left, did he say when he would be back?"
"As a human being, Your Highness cannot stay in the Demon Realm for too long."
A sly smile appeared on the corner of Hu Jiuyue's lips. She lowered her head and clearly saw with the corner of her eye that the fingertips of Tu Shan Qingqiu trembled slightly - the hand that had calmly closed the cuffs just now was now clasped on the edge of the case, with its knuckles turning white.
There was a wind blowing through the bamboo forest outside the window, making the documents on the case rustle——
Tu Shan Qingqiu's voice was very calm, as if he was repeating an insignificant gossip.
"Sister Patriarch..." Hu Jiuyue put down his pen and stood up carefully, "Your Highness was walking in a hurry and didn't say it clearly. This is just my guess."
"The affairs with the Silver Moon Wolf Clan are finished, maybe -"
Tushan Qingqiu's face was extremely stiff: "Since he has left, there is no need to come back."
"We in Tushan are not at the point where we can't function without a human race!"
"Okay, do your job well. I may be in seclusion frequently during this period, and Tushan's burden will fall on you."
Tushan Qingqiu patted Hu Jiuyue on the shoulder, turned around and left directly.
Tu Liuhu Jiuyue looked confused, "No, sister patriarch, he came back, he came back, I was just joking just now, a joke..."
